units.CD9207-mweka: Mweka territory (Kasaï) comprises the Mweka, Kakenge, Bulape and Mushenge areas, including the heartland of the Kuba kingdom (royal capital Mushenge/Nsheng). It saw limited spill-over of the Kamuina Nsapu insurgency in 2017, but militias were defeated or demobilised by 2018-2019 and no armed group is known to hold territory as of 2026. Mweka town is policed by the PNC with FARDC and ANR present; rural areas fall under PNC posts and customary chiefs. The Bulape Ebola outbreak (Sept-Dec 2025) was a health rather than security crisis. Live web research was unavailable in this run, so assessments rest on background knowledge and default state presence with limited confidence.
